items.title: Axis Communications Vulnerability Exposes Azure Storage Account Credentials
items.description: A critical vulnerability in Axis Communications’ Autodesk Revit plugin has exposed Azure Storage Account credentials, creating significant security risks for customers and potentially enabling supply chain attacks targeting the architecture and engineering industry. The vulnerability stems from hardcoded credentials embedded within signed Dynamic Link Libraries (DLLs) distributed to customers…
